docusign-api.$comment: All requests to the DocuSign eSignature REST API: the account.docusign.com auth/userinfo host and every regional API host (e.g. na4.docusign.net, na4-app.docusign.net, eu.docusign.net), plus their demo/sandbox variants (account-d.docusign.com, demo.docusign.net). The bearer is minted from the user's web session and injected on all of these.

docusign-read-all.$comment: Read anything from the DocuSign eSignature API: list and inspect envelopes, templates, folders, recipients, and documents, download signed documents, and read account info (userinfo). Safe method only.

docusign-write-all.$comment: Change anything through the DocuSign eSignature API: create and send envelopes (request signatures), update or correct them, void or delete envelopes, manage templates and recipients, and create recipient/sender/console view URLs. Every unsafe method.
